_comment: Copy this to autonomy_scope.json (gitignored) and fill in YOUR real paths. Every folder Jarvis's file tools (list_files/read_file/create_file/edit_file/move_file) can reach is listed here - see autonomy_scope.py for the full resolution rules. mode is "read_only" or "read_write". subject is optional metadata (one of jarvis_core.STUDY_SUBJECTS) or null. allowed_extensions is optional and only NARROWS what's readable/writable in that folder, never widens it.
